en-US.description: Upload flat lay or mannequin garment images and a target model image to generate a commercial try-on image.
en-US.empty.bottomGarmentImage: Please upload the bottom garment image first
en-US.empty.modelImage: Please upload the target model image first
en-US.empty.onePieceGarmentImage: Please upload the one-piece garment image first
en-US.empty.separatesGarmentImage: Please upload at least one top or bottom garment image first
en-US.empty.topGarmentImage: Please upload the top garment image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.garmentMode.onePiece.desc: Upload one flat lay or mannequin image for dresses, jumpsuits, robes, or other one-piece garments.
en-US.garmentMode.separates.desc: Upload separate upper and lower garment images such as tops, pants, skirts, or shoes.
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Adds realistic dressing decisions and stronger garment detail fidelity, including tuck behavior, strap handling, folds, and fabric-aware drape.
en-US.generationMode.fast.desc: Estimated generation time: 20s. For better results, use simple poses and target model images whose original garment silhouettes are similar to the uploaded garments.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Balanced commercial try-on mode for everyday production samples.
en-US.label: Dress Up Try-On
en-US.toast.success: Flat lay / mannequin try-on image generated successfully!
en-US.upload.bottomGarmentImage.help: Use a clear flat lay or mannequin photo with visible lower-garment boundaries and minimal occlusion.
en-US.upload.modelImage.help: Use a model image with a simple pose, visible clothing area, and a framing range you want to preserve.
en-US.upload.onePieceGarmentImage.help: Use a clear flat lay or mannequin photo that fully shows the one-piece silhouette and structure.
en-US.upload.topGarmentImage.help: Use a clear flat lay or mannequin photo with visible upper-garment boundaries and minimal occlusion.

zh-CN.description: 上传平铺/人台服饰图和模特图，一键生成服饰上身商拍图。
zh-CN.empty.separatesGarmentImage: 请至少上传上装图或下装图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.garmentMode.onePiece.desc: 适合连衣裙、连体裤、长袍等单张完整服饰图。
zh-CN.garmentMode.separates.desc: 适合分别上传上装和下装，例如上衣、裤子、裙子或鞋子。
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 除细节增强外，还会补充更真实的穿着决策，例如掖衣、肩带处理、折叠方式和材质驱动的垂坠表现。
zh-CN.generationMode.fast.desc: 预计生成时间20s，为获得理想结果，建议选择姿势简单，以及身着服饰与上传服饰版型相似的模特图。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 适合常规商拍试衣样本，平衡效果稳定性与生成效率。
zh-CN.label: 平铺/人台试衣
zh-CN.toast.success: 平铺/人台试衣图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.bottomGarmentImage.help: 建议上传边界清晰、无遮挡、下装轮廓完整可见的平铺或人台服饰图。
zh-CN.upload.modelImage.help: 建议模特姿势简单、待替换区域完整可见，并尽量与上传服饰版型相近。
zh-CN.upload.onePieceGarmentImage.help: 建议上传服饰轮廓完整、结构清晰、无遮挡的平铺或人台图。
zh-CN.upload.topGarmentImage.help: 建议上传边界清晰、无遮挡、上装轮廓完整可见的平铺或人台服饰图。
